newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera tobacco said sales slowed by tax.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera tobacco said sales slowed by tax.

text.p: Spanish tobacco group Tabacalera said on Monday that its cigarrette sales in the first nine months of the year had been slowed by its decision not to pass on a tax hike implemented in the summer.
Tabacalera said cigarrette sales rose 9.2 percent in the first nine months compared to the prior year period.
"This rise was slowed by the decision not to pass on the last tax rise, effective July 31, to final Virginia tobacco prices," the group said in a statement.

Nonetheless, Tabacalera said ordinary results rose more than 13 percent, totalling 14.55 billion pesetas, reflecting good developmnets in general expenditures, even after major business investments of some 1.6 billion pesetas.
